title: Polyverse App
tagline: Virtual Amazon - Empowering users with digital assets (NFTs) that are interoperable.
description:
Problem: Currently, when you have a digital asset like a game asset or skin on web2 platforms like Roblox or Minecraft, you can only experience them only in the eco-system. 

Solution: We executed a solution to empower users to truly own digital assets by taking it across different web3 platforms. For example: An Avatar that user can take it from Monaverse and Spatial.
how_its_made: The project uses metamask wallet to connect and writes data to the @Polygon blockchain. We can't find a better blockchain than Polygon to support our high volume and economical gas fees. The infrastructure then ships digital assets (NFTs) to multiple metaverse like Monaverse & Spatial.
